water.name: Land
water.rule: Land hex within Central Asia or neighboring Eurasia.

water.name: Deep sea
water.rule: Caspian Sea deeper than 200 m and not next to land.

water.name: Shallow coast
water.rule: Caspian shelf next to land or shallower than 200 m.

water.name: Inland lake
water.rule: Major inland lake (Aral Sea, Lake Balkhash, Issyk-Kul, Zaysan, Alakol, Aydarkul).

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Low local elevation spread (plains, steppes, deserts, river valleys).

relief.name: Hills
relief.rule: Moderate relief (uplands, foothills, Kazakh Uplands, Ustyurt escarpment).

relief.name: Mountains
relief.rule: High relief (Tian Shan, Altai, Kopet Dag, Pamir foothills).

relief.name: Alpine peaks
relief.rule: Extreme alpine relief above 3,000 m (High Pamirs, Central Tian Shan, Khan Tengri).

cover.name: Mountain & taiga forest
cover.rule: MODIS evergreen forest (Altai & Tian Shan spruce)

cover.name: Cropland & irrigated oasis
cover.rule: MODIS cropland (Northern wheat belt, Fergana, Zarafshan & Amu Darya oases)

cover.name: Delta & wetland
cover.rule: MODIS permanent wetlands (Syr Darya, Amu Darya & Ili deltas)

cover.name: Desert & barren rock
cover.rule: MODIS barren sand desert (Karakum, Kyzylkum) & alpine rock

cover.name: Glaciers & permanent snow
cover.rule: MODIS snow/ice & alpine peaks above 4,000 m
